citation.description: wait_for_jira_dc_ready performs a two-stage wait: stage 1 polls serverInfo, stage 2 calls jira_dc_field_readiness.await_required_fields with _REQUIRED_FIELDS. _REQUIRED_FIELDS is assigned from jira_dc_field_readiness.REQUIRED_FIELDS (line 456).

criteria.criterion: readiness for the live-DC tiers requires every `_REQUIRED_FIELDS` name to be present in `/rest/api/2/field`, not merely a 200 from `serverInfo`

citation.description: FIELD_READY_BUDGET_S=600.0 bounds the wait; not_ready_message embeds describe_inventory(status, body) which quotes the observed field names and HTTP status. The test test_the_not_ready_failure_dumps_the_observed_inventory (test_live_jira_dc_conftest.py:322) pins this.

criteria.criterion: the wait has its own bounded budget, and on expiry fails with the observed field inventory in the message so the failure is self-diagnosing

citation.description: _assert_project_capabilities calls jira_dc_field_readiness.not_ready_message which contains both 'never registered within that budget (a READINESS/TIMING failure)' and 'this image does not offer them at all (a GENUINE DEGRADE)'. The AC3 test (test_live_jira_dc_conftest.py:368) asserts both phrases appear.

criteria.criterion: `_assert_project_capabilities`'s message no longer attributes a missing Epic field to an image degrade without first distinguishing 'not registered yet' from 'not offered by this image'

citation.description: The probe imports jira_dc_field_readiness and _await_named_fields delegates entirely to jira_dc_field_readiness.await_required_fields. The harness conftest (line 66) also imports jira_dc_field_readiness and _REQUIRED_FIELDS is assigned from jira_dc_field_readiness.REQUIRED_FIELDS. The AC4 test (test_live_jira_dc_conftest.py:389) pins that both tiers route through the same module.

criteria.criterion: the probe workflow and the harness workflow share one readiness definition, so they cannot drift

citation.description: test_a_system_only_field_inventory_reads_as_not_ready stubs the transport with _SYSTEM_ONLY_FIELDS (no customfield_*) and asserts wait_for_jira_dc_ready raises RuntimeError naming Epic Link and Epic Name. test_an_unreadable_field_inventory_reads_as_not_ready (line 435) covers the 503 case.

criteria.criterion: a test pins that a field-inventory response containing only system fields is treated as NOT ready rather than as a degraded image
